behaviors.source: #85 AC8, AC9; D8; ADR 0012; src/gate-policy.ts:325; src/acceptance-manifest.ts:360-392
behaviors.given: a project with or without gatePolicy.acceptance and with or without a tests script, and a manifest binding a behavior to that gate

behaviors.then: the declared member is the plan and needs no tests script; the derived plan — pnpm exec vitest run --reporter=json --testNamePattern {behaviorId}, matcher vitest-json — applies only when the member is absent and resolveSanityPlan yields a tests step; with neither there is no plan and no entry; otherwise the catalog carries { id: acceptance:behaviors, command, args } from the resolved plan, read via loadGatePolicy(cwd) and shown by formatBaseGateCatalog, so the binding is accepted under either source and an undeclared ID refused by name

behaviors.source: #85 AC3; D8; Testing decision 1; vitest 3.2.4 JSON reporter and @vitest/runner interpretTaskModes
behaviors.given: a parsed --reporter=json document from a name-filtered run
behaviors.when: the exported vitest-json matcher grades it
behaviors.then: matched is numPassedTests + numFailedTests; matched 0 is untested; numFailedTests > 0 is failed; PASS is matched >= 1 with numFailedTests === 0; numTotalTests is not the match count (a filtered run counts non-matching tests there as skipped); a skipped- or todo-only match is not covered
behaviors.observableResult: unit tests over documents transcribed verbatim from three real filtered runs — match-and-pass, match-and-fail, no-match — spawning no vitest

behaviors.given: a locked acceptance-manifest.json and a candidate checkpoint
behaviors.when: the declaration builder runs and its run executes
behaviors.then: one aggregate { id: acceptance:behaviors, stage: acceptance, required: true, run }, and nothing when the manifest binds no behavior to that ID; run reads the manifest at call time, selects the bound behaviors, substitutes each into every {behaviorId} occurrence of B-02's plan, runs it once per behavior in ctx.cwd, and stops on an aborted ctx.signal without reporting PASS
behaviors.observableResult: unit tests with an injected runner: declaration shape, absence when nothing is bound, per-behavior argv, abort

behaviors.source: #85 AC1, AC2, AC4, AC5; D8; ADR 0041
